column1: TABLE 1. Data on body and brain weight (in g and mg) and volume of the fundamental brain sections (in mm³) in Insectivores.
* Body weight from Bauchot and Stephan (1966, 1969), except Nycticebus cougang and Macaca mulatta.
† Brain weight from Bauchot and Stephan (1966, 1969), except Macaca mulatta.
‡ Total brain net volume; ventricles, meningeal membranes and nerves are excluded.
§ Medulla oblongata includes tissue difficult to separate from mesencephalon.
‖ Cerebellum includes brachium and nuclei pontis.
